predict.question: B has equally likely net schedule scores +50 and −30. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Waltzing with Bears argues for acknowledging uncertainty instead of treating a single project estimate as a guarantee.
modelBoundary: Both A and B average {A} points. B can still lose 30, while A’s lower branch is zero; equal means do not erase downside. Scores are invented net outcomes, not durations or a deadline-risk distribution.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
